entries.title: The task board shows your backlog again
entries.body: Backlog is the board's first column again, beside Queued and Working. It shows your first five tasks, and Browse all opens the whole backlog. You can drag a task into it or out of it again. This week's done work now opens from its Done · 7d button, which keeps its count.

picture.alt: The task board with Backlog, Queued and Working columns, and Board, Backlog and Done · 7d buttons with their counts
